text: My daily routine is quite simple, but I try to stay consistent. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a short walk. After breakfast, I begin work at nine and check my emails first. I work until five, with a lunch break around noon. In the afternoon, I often go to the gym or run in the park for about an hour. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, or read a book. I go to bed before eleven because regular sleep helps me feel energetic and focused every day.
